 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Vinay Gandhi appeared for appellant.

Ms.Neelu Khetra appearing on behalf of Advocate Gener  ORDER Heard .
1.The present appeal has been filed under Section 372 of CrPC against the order dated 15.5.2019 passed in Criminal Case No. 300269/2014.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the respondent/accused has committed rape on the pretext of marriage whereas he was already married.
Inspite of that the learned Trial Court has wrongly acquitted the respondent.
Hence, the petition has been filed being aggrieved by the order of acquittal.
3. I have heard the matter and perused the record.

4. On going through the statement of prosecutrix, it emerges that the prosecutrix was well aware of the fact that the appellant is married man before making relations and the relations are appear to be consensual.
As such, learned Trial Court has not committed any error in passing the order 2 CRA-7195-2019 order of acquittal under the offence of 376(2)(b)(n) and 506 of IPC.
Hence, the impugned order does not warrant any interference, hence the present criminal appeal stands dismissed at the admission stage.
5. Accordingly, the present criminal appeal stands dismissed.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Prembai Gayri vs Kailash Gayri on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187984444/
